Bayesian Conformal Aggregation (BCA)
Copyright 2026 David Bayha

This distribution contains software derived from:
- CORL, https://github.com/corl-team/CORL (Apache License 2.0).
- Unifloral, https://github.com/EmptyJackson/Unifloral (Apache License 2.0),
  Copyright 2025 Matthew Jackson.

Modifications by David Bayha include Bayesian/conformal calibration, host-specific
full-width objectives, control arms, shared IQL nuisance models, data reservation,
and explicit experiment protocols. The clean repository relocates imports,
consolidates configurations, and replaces machine-specific launch infrastructure.
Original source identities are recorded in configs/sources.json.

baselines/unifloral contains the complete unmodified Unifloral source snapshot at
f2dc1278eae18ed3e22c92255119c54885414d17. Its original Apache 2.0 LICENSE,
README, algorithms, configuration and environment files are retained verbatim.
Every vendored file is identified in configs/unifloral.json. BCA modifications
are outside that snapshot.
